notes.title: Steam Workshop Full Integration Update
notes.notes: [p]Kurisu v1.3.0 now features full Steam Workshop upload functionality! Users can edit, configure, and upload workshop items directly through the application interface.[/p][p][b]Key New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Direct Workshop Access[/b] - Access workshop functionality directly from main interface[/p][/*][*][p][b]Visual Editor[/b] - Configure projects through graphical interface without manual JSON editing[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multi-Command Management[/b] - Create, edit, and manage multiple FFmpeg commands[/p][/*][*][p][b]Real-time Preview[/b] - Instantly preview configuration effects[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multi-language Support[/b] - Support for Chinese, English, Japanese and other languages[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Detailed Usage Guide[/b][/p][p][b]1. Workshop Project Configuration[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Project ID[/b]: Enter a unique numeric ID (e.g., 1001, 1002, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Project Name[/b]: Name your workshop project[/p][/*][*][p][b]Project Family[/b]: Specify the series or category of the project[/p][/*][*][p][b]Project Description[/b]: Detailed description of project functionality and purpose[/p][/*][*][p][b]Usage Instructions[/b]: Provide user guidance[/p][/*][/list][p][b]2. FFmpeg Command Configuration[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Command Name[/b]: Assign an easily recognizable name for each FFmpeg command[/p][/*][*][p][b]Command Description[/b]: Brief explanation of the command's purpose[/p][/*][*][p][b]FFmpeg Command[/b]: Enter the complete FFmpeg processing command[/p][/*][/list][p][b]3. Path Variables Explanation[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Input File Path Variable[/b]: ${filePath} - User-selected input file path[/p][/*][*][p][b]Output File Path Variable[/b]: ${outputPath} - System-generated output file path[/p][/*][*][p][b]Command Example[/b]: ffmpeg -i ${filePath} -y -c:v libx264 -crf 23 ${outputPath}${.mp4}[/p][/*][/list][p][b]4. Upload Process[/b][/p][olist][*][p]After configuration, click "Choose Preview Image" to upload project cover[/p][/*][*][p]Click "Upload to Workshop" to start the upload process[/p][/*][*][p]System will automatically process and publish to Steam Workshop[/p][/*][/olist]

notes.title: 1.1.4 Update Notes
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] The icon for uploading files now has a white border after files are uploaded.
[*] A new option "Rename only" has been added to the settings. If you're using the software for batch renaming only, you can check this option to speed up the process significantly.
[/list]
